parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json,taskId=String(r.task_id??r.data?.task_id??'').trim();if(!taskId)throw new Error('DiscoGen did not return a task ID: '+JSON.stringify(r).slice(0,1200));return [{json:{taskId}}];

const r=$input.first().json,s=String(r.status??r.data?.status??'').toLowerCase();if(['failed','error','cancelled','canceled'].includes(s))throw new Error('DiscoGen enrichment failed: '+String(r.error??r.message??JSON.stringify(r)).slice(0,1500));return [{json:{...r,isComplete:s==='completed'}}];

const meta=$input.first().json,p=$('Build Enriched Sheet Values').first().json,requests=[];for(const title of ['Final Direct','Final Generic']){const values=p.tabValues[title],found=(meta.sheets??[]).find(s=>s.properties?.title===title),rows=Math.max(1000,values.length+20),cols=Math.max(30,values[0].length+5);if(found)requests.push({updateSheetProperties:{properties:{sheetId:found.properties.sheetId,gridProperties:{rowCount:Math.max(found.properties.gridProperties?.rowCount??0,rows),columnCount:Math.max(found.properties.gridProperties?.columnCount??0,cols)}},fields:'gridProperties.rowCount,gridProperties.columnCount'}});else requests.push({addSheet:{properties:{title,gridProperties:{rowCount:rows,columnCount:cols}}}})}return[{json:{...p,requests}}];

const p=$('Ensure Final Tabs Capacity').first().json,scope=p.scopeMode==='company'?'company':'person',message='Enrichment complete: '+p.rowCount+' campaign-ready rows updated in Final Direct ('+p.directCount+') and Final Generic ('+p.genericCount+') from '+p.entityCount+' unique '+scope+(p.entityCount===1?'':' entities')+'; '+p.missing+' requested values were blank and require QA.'+(p.skippedCount?' '+p.skippedCount+' contacts lacked the required person identifier and were skipped.':'');return[{json:{recordId:p.recordId,body:{fields:{'Processing Status':'Completed','Processing Started At':$('Mark Enrichment Running').first().json.fields['Processing Started At'],'Processing Completed At':new Date().toISOString(),'Workflow Run ID':String($execution.id),'Processing Progress':5/7,'Lead List Stage':'QA','Last Workflow Message':message,'Last Workflow Error':'','Enrichment Action':null}}}}];

parameters.jsCode: const p=$('Ensure Final Tabs Capacity1').first().json,values=p.tabValues['Final Direct']??[],size=500,out=[];for(let i=0;i<values.length;i+=size)out.push({json:{sheetId:p.sheetId,startRow:i+1,values:values.slice(i,i+size),chunkIndex:Math.floor(i/size)+1,totalChunks:Math.ceil(values.length/size),tab:'Final Direct'}});return out;
return [{json:{completedDirectChunks:$input.all().length}}];

return [{json:{completedGenericChunks:$input.all().length}}];
